messages:
eve_customer: Hi, our requests started routing to us-west instead of eu-west after a proxy update. Affected endpoints returning higher latency and some auth failures.

alice_support: Sorry about that — can you paste a raw request header you sent? any client library or proxy in front?

eve_customer: We have a CDN + an internal proxy. Here's the header we log at the proxy:```
X-Client-Region: us:eu-west, eu-west
X-Forwarded-For: 34.82.1.12
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```

alice_support: Hmm, the router expects a single region token or a comma-separated list. That `us:eu-west` looks weird.

bob_engineer: I think the prefix with colon might be parsed by our header sanitizer as an identifier (e.g., `us:...` -> region key `us`). If router sees `us` first, it will prefer west. Can you confirm the raw bytes? sometimes proxies stringify arrays oddly.

eve_customer: We send region via our SDK which builds the header from an internal config map. After a deploy we see `region = ["us:eu-west", "eu-west"]` being joined with a comma.

charlie_devops: @bob_engineer routing-bot, can you show policy precedence for multi-valued X-Client-Region? are prefixes allowed?

routing-bot: Routing precedence: 1) explicit single region token header (no separators), 2) first token in comma-separated header, 3) query param, 4) client IP geolocation. Prefixes with non-alpha characters may be trimmed and first alpha chunk used.

bob_engineer: That explains it — `us:eu-west` when trimmed becomes `us` (first token), so router picks west. This is a mismatch between how SDK formats the region and what router accepts.

alice_support: Workaround for customer: can you patch the proxy to normalize header to the last token, or set query param `region=eu-west` until we fix SDK?

eve_customer: We can hotfix proxy to strip prefixes. Quick question: any billing impact for being routed to wrong region?
\alice_support: Potentially higher egress and cold-starts; I'll flag billing to monitor.

bob_engineer: Long term fix: update router header parsing to prefer a token that matches known region patterns (e.g., `^eu-|^us-`), and add a normalization layer that rejects tokens containing `:`. Also push a minor SDK release to join arrays with `,` but sanitize prefixes.

charlie_devops: I'll patch an ingress rule to drop colon-prefixed tokens and rewrite header:```
# nginx snippet
map $http_x_client_region $norm_region {
  default $http_x_client_region;
  ~*:(.*) $1; # strip prefix before comma handling
}
proxy_set_header X-Client-Region $norm_region;
```

eve_customer: Thanks, will deploy proxy fix now and confirm.

alice_support: Please update thread when you confirm. I'll create a follow-up ticket to track SDK + router changes. :thumbsup:

eve_customer: Deployed the proxy patch, latency back to normal, no auth errors. Thanks all.

bob_engineer: Filed INF-2145 to harden parser and INF-2146 for SDK sanitize.

alice_support: Closing interim support escalations, will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
